[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Align all decimal numbers to the same length by adding trailing zeros.

0.7000 + 0.0700 + 0.0070 + 0.0007

Summing each decimal place: 0.7 in the 1st place, 7 in the 2nd, 7 in the 3rd, and 7 in the 4th.

Total = 0.7777.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.7777.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expression: 0.0007 + 0.07 + 0.007 + 0.7

To add decimals, arrange them vertically by aligning the decimal points:

⇒ 0.7000

⇒ 0.0700

⇒ 0.0070

⇒ 0.0007

⇒ ____________

⇒ Sum = 0.7777

**∴ The correct answer is 0.7777.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Decimal Addition Rule

Always align the decimal points vertically. If a number has fewer decimal places than others, add trailing zeros to balance the length for easier calculation.

BODMAS in Simplification

For mixed operations, follow the order: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Place Value of Decimals

The positions to the right of the decimal point represent tenths (10−¹), hundredths (10−²), thousandths (10−³), and ten-thousandths (10−⁴).
